name: me-network-ae2-textures
title: ME Network - AE2 Textures
author: rykon_
description: Optional graphics for ME Network: textures of Applied Energistics 2 in place of ME Network's own sprites. The textures are by AlgorithmX2 et al. (and, in today's AE2, Ridanisaurus Rid) under CC BY-NC-SA 3.0, and so is everything in this mod: no commercial use, changed versions under the same license. Install ME Network too; it runs without this mod. It replaces the icons of the storage cells, components and housing, the upgrade cards and the patterns, and the ME Controller, Drive, Chest, Interface, Pattern Provider, Molecular Assembler, Cell Workbench and Charger with AE2's blocks, the ME Terminal and Pattern Terminal with AE2's panels, the ME Import, Export and Storage Bus with AE2's bus fronts, the cable with AE2's Fluix glass cable, and the blocks of a Crafting CPU with AE2's crafting blocks. Source: https://github.com/Rykon00/me-network (folder ae2-textures)
